c563dbf6eda91b4e.original_query: Orders still pending payment after 30 days
c563dbf6eda91b4e.compiled_sql:
SELECT CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS `Order Status`, o.Id AS `Number of Orders`, o.OrderTotal AS `Order Total`, o.CreatedOnUtc AS `Order Date`
FROM `Order` o
WHERE 1=1
  AND o.CreatedOnUtc <= DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE 'Unknown' END = @p0
  AND o.CreatedOnUtc <= DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
ORDER BY CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE 'Unknown' END asc
LIMIT 100
